For this small rented root crop plot, I will keep my spending low and use mostly the labor from my household. I do not plan to buy chemical fertilizer because on this kind of plot I can still manage with the soil and some organic matter, and I will plant the local planting material I can get more easily. I do not expect to irrigate, and I am not likely to use pesticide unless there is a serious problem. I may hire a few labor days for heavier work, but most of the work will be done by my family.
